title: A void or never property passes the check that refuses those types outside a return.
text: `E0742` refuses `void` and `never` on a parameter (`reject_void_or_never_params`) and on a local (`locals.rs`), and `rule:types/grammar` makes both return-only, but a property declared `public void $x;` is not refused: it fails only on what follows, `E0409` with no default or `E0472` ("a property default must be a `void` constant") with one. It closes when a `void` or `never` property is `E0742`, with a conformance case for each.
